generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The contractor shall maintain the road periodically during the DLP, including removal of jungle, shoulder, drains and cross drain works asper the site conditions &as per the directions of Engineer in charge of work.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the tenderer in complete manner otherwise it will be rejected

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of KPP portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder
Conditional tenders will not be accepted
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs
The cost of the Tender processing fee shall not be refundable
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing KPP Portal

In the case of the death of the contractor after executing the agreement / commencement of the work, his/her legal heir, if is an eligible registered contractor and is willing can execute and compete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work
The intending contractors are requested to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the Standard Tender documents KW-3 K.P.W.D. and further orders thereon

The successful Tenderer shall deliver to the Employer a Security deposit in any of the forms given Clause 25.1 of ITT for an amount equivalent to 5% of the Contract price plus additional security for unbalanced tenders in accordance with Clause 25.4 of ITT and Clause44 of the Conditions of Contract
Materials like steel, cement etc., required for the work shall be procured by the tenderer themselves and should got tested by the quality control authority before use on the work at their own cost.
The contractors assessed available tender capacity will be calculated as per the clause 3.5 of STD tender document Attached.

All the items in the tender including all lead, lifts, loading unloading, transportation, labor, hire charges of machinery curing for concrete works, cost and conveyance of all material and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completion of works as per the detailed technical specification and direction of Engineer in charge of this work
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt orders.

As per Karnataka state Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01.01.2007and Government letter no PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.2007, a sum amounting to 1%of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labor welfare fund.
The employer reserves the rights to Reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons
The difference amount and the percent security deposit submitted by the contractor for the project will be released upon completion of the defect liability period and receipt of the final bill

As per Government circular no: FD 355 EXP 12/2024 dtd 01.08.2024, Letter of Intent (LoI)will be issued in Karnataka Public Procurement Portal 2.0 software, contractor has to accept LOI online and submit the BG s through KPP portal within 20 days. if not tender will be rejected as per Guidelines.

All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original and the Executive Engineer reserves the right to verify the documents before approval. All the originals of uploaded documents in KPP portal should be produced within 7 working days from the date of opening of Technical Bid at the Division Office, failing which the tender is liable for rejection. No separate communication will be made in this regard, failing which action will be taken as per tender conditions and registration rules

All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incident happens on account of negligence or any project activity. Contractor should indemnify the client to that extent
Formation levels and other data furnished are bare minimum the contractor should make all efforts to validate and to get additional data if required at his own cost
Contractor to that extent should submit HSE document defining all the procedure including the policies before execution of the project.

Contractor should take all precautionary measures to ensure that no damages caused to the existing structures which have been constructed by other agencies during project execution If any damages caused it has to be rectified at his own risk & cost
Further particulars, if any, required by the Contractor can be had from the office of the Executive Engineer, PWD Division, Kolar during office hours on all working days
The Bankers certificate should be in prescribed format which is enclosed separately

The units specifications against the item codes in BOQ to be referred as per UNI SR 2023-24continued to 2025-26 vol.1,2,3,5,6. The description in UNI 2023-24 continued to2025-26 vol1,2,3,5,6 are final.
Contractor should establish a fully functional laboratory at site at no extra cost in order to carry out all the required tests for the materials being used in the project.
Contractor should carryout additional test required to test the suitability of materials including borrow area before using the same either as sub-grade or base course materials.

When embankments are constructed disputes arising on account of damages to the existing field / channels, bunds and other private properties, if any, has to be resolved by the contractor. All precautions should be taken by the contractor so that there are no damages to such public private properties.

The tenderer who quotes amount less than amount put to tender should pay difference amount in the form of FDR purchased through any nationalized bank payable at KOLAR only in favor The Executive Engineer at the time of execution of the tender agreement
If any postponement of receipt date of tender, the same will be published in the KPP Portal portal

The contractor who participates in tenders for more than one work for which tenders are invited in this IFT, the tenderer must fulfill all the conditions and criteria cumulatively for the participated works

The returns submitted to the I.T. along with the Profit and Loss account statement should be uploaded for the financial turnover criteria attested by Chartered Accountant. The Turnover certificate should be obtained from the Chartered Accountant having UDIN number, if failed to satisfy the condition the tender will be Rejected
Contractor should execute the project with least impact to the environment especially during Cement concrete work.
MSME and NSIC Certificates are not valid as EMD payment as per GO.295/2019/ Dt. 26-03-2019.

For the vehicles/machineries/ equipments for which RTO registration is statutory,for such vehicles/machineries / equipments the contractor should upload the Registration Certificate documents issued by RTO. For Machineries and other equipments for which RTO registration is not applicable, for such machineries and equipments, purchase invoice document should be uploaded. If there is sale deed for such machineries and equipments, original invoice along with registered sale deed should be uploaded.

Contractors participating in the bid should submit Original Line of Credit of the copy uploaded through KPPP Portal with in one week after the last date of receipt of tenders. failing which their technical bids will be rejected.
LOC / K-form for the stipulated amount should be submitted in the format as prescribed in the bid document only. Otherwise tender is liable for rejection
The defect liability period for this project shall be one year

Estimate rates are excluding GST as per common SR 23-24 and Continued to 2026-27 prevailing GST (18% of amount put to tender) and in sanctioned estimate according to guidelines in common SR. hence GST will be paid separately for the quoted amount accordingly.
Contractors Should be registered with KPWD Class-3 and above
The duration for completion of work is 6 months including monsoons

The contractor / supplier shall attach scanned Bank Guarantee along with the bid on KP-procurement portal and submit the original Bank Guarantee to the Executive Engineer PWD Division Kolar on before the last date and time notified in the Tender Document to the Tender Inviting authority. If The Contractor fails to submit such tenders will be rejected.
Contractor should not have gone through termination of any work

technicalCriterionList.description: 3.2 b. To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26 satisfactorily completed (At least 90% of the Contract Value) as a prime contractor at least ONE SIMILAR NATURE OF WORK Such as CONSTRUCTION OF CC ROAD to an extent of 50% of the cost of the work, of any construction work of value not less than Rs. 40.26 Lakhs (Past experience) Certified duly by the 0fficer not below the rank of Executive Engineer

3.2 c. executed in any one year in the last five years i.e. 2021.22 to 2025-26, the following minimum 80% quantities of work: 1) EWE/Embankment/Subgrade/Earthen Shoulders in Cum-1069.00 2) WMM/GSB in Cum-80.32 3) PCC/RCC/DLC in Cum-492.00.00 Cum 4) PQC in Cum - 157.00 5) Steel Reinforcement in MT - 18.70 (80% of peak rate of construction)

3.1All Tenderers shall provide the requested information accurately and in sufficient detail in Section 3 Qualification information. 1.To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26 achieved in at least two financial years an average minimum financial turnover(in all classes of civil engineering construction works only) of Rs.80.52 Lakhs Financial Status(Certificate from CA with UDIN Number, if Failed to satisfy the condition tender will be rejected) (The turn over certificate shall have UDIN generated through ICAI Portal. Turn over certificate without UDIN will not be considered and treated as invalid. The confirmation letter issued by Chartered Accountant shall also have UDIN generated through ICAI Portal)

technicalCriterionList.description: Liquid assets and /or availability of credit facilities of no less than Rs. 24.16 Lakhs (estimated cash flow for 3 months of peak construction period)

3.5 Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under Assessed available tender capacity (A X N X2.5 - B)where A-Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years(updated to 2026-27 price level) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N-Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invite B- Value at 2026-27 price level of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 6 months (period of completion of the works for which Tenders are invited)

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Construction of CC Road from Ch.10.138 to 10.182km (Near Hudukula Bus Stop) and RCC Drain from Ch.8.94 to 10.292km Selected reaches in Bangarpet Taluk, Kolar Dist.

itemList.description: Clearing    and    grubbing    road    land    including    uprooting    rank vegetation,  grass,  bushes,  shrubs,  saplings  and  trees  girth  up  to 300  mm,  removal  of  stumps  of  trees  cut  earlier  and  disposal  of unserviceable  materials  and  stacking  of  serviceable  material  to be used or auctioned,  including removal and disposal of top organic soil not exceeding 150 mm in thickness. By Mechanical Means using Dozer - In area of light jungle ---- With all leads and lifts cost and conveyance of all materials, cost of labour, curing, hire charges of machinery equipment, transportation charges, loading and unloading chargesand all other incidental charges complete as per standard technical detailed specification and directions of the Engineer in charge of the work.(Rates are exclusive of GST)

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -3- EARTH WORK, EROSION CONTROL AND DRAINAGE
itemList.description: Scarifying the existing bituminous road surface to a depth of 50 mm and disposal of scarified material by Mechanical Means using Hydraulic excavator with in all lifts and lead. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 305.4.3 ---- With all leads and lifts cost and conveyance of all materials, cost of labour, curing, hire charges of machinery equipment, transportation charges, loading and unloading chargesand all other incidental charges complete as per standard technical detailed specification and directions of the Engineer in charge of the work.(Rates are exclusive of GST)

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -4- SUB-BASES, BASES (NON-BITUMINOUS), SHOULDERS AND STABILIZATION METHODS
itemList.description: Granular Sub-Base - Plant Mix Method - Construction   of   Granular   Sub-Base   of   required   grading   as per  design  mixing  in  a  mechanical  mix  plant  at  OMC,  carriage of  mixed  Material  to  work  site,  spreading  in  uniform  layers with  motor  grader  on  prepared  surface  and  compacting  with vibratory power roller to achieve the desired density, complete as per clause 401 - For Grading -V Material. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 401 ---- With all leads and lifts cost and conveyance of all materials, cost of labour, curing, hire charges of machinery equipment, transportation charges, loading and unloading chargesand all other incidental charges complete as per standard technical detailed specification and directions of the Engineer in charge of the work.(Rates are exclusive of GST)

Dry Lean Cement Concrete Sub-base - Construction  of  dry  lean  cement  concrete  Sub-  base  over  a prepared sub-grade with coarse and fine aggregate conforming to  IS:  383,  the  size  of  coarse  aggregate  not  exceeding  25  mm, aggregate cement ratio not to exceed 14:1, aggregate gradation after blending to be as per table 600-1, cement content not to be less than 140 kg/ m3 , optimum moisture content to be determined during trial length construction, concrete strength not to be less than 7 Mpa at 7 days, mixed in a batching plant, transported to site,  laid  with  a  paver  with  electronic  sensor,  compacting  with 8-10 t vibratory roller, finishing and curing. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - IRC SP 49:2014 ---- With all leads and lifts cost and conveyance of all materials, cost of labour, curing, hire charges of machinery equipment, transportation charges, loading and unloading chargesand all other incidental charges complete as per standard technical detailed specification and directions of the Engineer in charge of the work.(Rates are exclusive of GST)

Pavement Quality Concrete using paver - M40 Grade - Construction   of   M40   Grade   un-reinforced,   dowel   jointed, plain  cement  concrete  pavement  over  a  prepared  sub  base  in recommended proportions, coarse and fine aggregate conforming to IS 383:2016, maximum size of coarse aggregate not exceeding 25  mm,  mixed  in  a  batching  and  mixing  plant  as  per  approved mix design transported to site, laid with a slip form paver finisher, spread,   compacted   and   finished   in   a   continuous   operation including provision of contraction, expansion, construction and longitudinal  joints,  joint  filler,  separation  membrane,  sealant primer,   joint   sealant,   debonding   strip,   dowel   bar,   tie   rod, admixtures, curing compound, steel channels, finishing to lines and grades as per drawing OPC @ 420 kg/m3 ---- With all leads and lifts cost and conveyance of all materials, cost of labour, curing, hire charges of machinery equipment, transportation charges, loading and unloading chargesand all other incidental charges complete as per standard technical detailed specification and directions of the Engineer in charge of the work.(Rates are exclusive of GST)

Mechanical Means -
Earth work excavation for Foundation by mechanical means  for all   works   & depth upto 3 m, as per drawing and technical  specifications, including setting out,     shoring,  strutting,  barricading,  caution  lights,     including  dressing  of excavated  surfaces,  disposing  off  or  levelling  the  excavated  earth  or  sorting &   stacking the selected   earth for reuse in a radius of   50 m and lift upto 1.5 m  including  cost  of  labour,  tools,  usage  of  machinery  &  other  appurtenaces required to complete the work. In all kinds of soils  Depth upto 3 m ---- With all leads and lifts cost and conveyance of all materials, cost of labour, curing, hire charges of machinery equipment, transportation charges, loading and unloading chargesand all other incidental charges complete as per standard technical detailed specification and directions of the Engineer in charge of the work.(Rates are exclusive of GST)

Providing  and  laying  in  position  Cement  Concrete  for  levelling  course  for all  works  in  foundation.  The    granite/trap/basalt    crushed  graded  coarse aggregates  and fine aggregates  as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts,  cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing,  and all the other  appurtenances  required to complete the work as per technical specifications. - Mix 1:3:6 Using 40 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse  aggregates ---- With all leads and lifts cost and conveyance of all materials, cost of labour, curing, hire charges of machinery equipment, transportation charges, loading and unloading chargesand all other incidental charges complete as per standard technical detailed specification and directions of the Engineer in charge of the work.(Rates are exclusive of GST)

Providing  and  laying  in  position  Cement  Concrete   for  all  Sub  structures  of building,  Irrigation  works,  Sub  structure  works  of  bridges,  Drain  works    & other  parallel  works  from  0.50m  to  3.50  m  height.  The  granite/trap/basalt crushed  graded  coarse  aggregates    and  fine  aggregates    as  per  relevant  IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers,   laid in layers, well compacted using needle   vibrators, providing weep holes wherever necessary, including all lead & lifts,  cost of all materials of quality, confirming to the requirements of   relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. - M 20   Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse  aggregates ---- With all leads and lifts cost and conveyance of all materials, cost of labour, curing, hire charges of machinery equipment, transportation charges, loading and unloading chargesand all other incidental charges complete as per standard technical detailed specification and directions of the Engineer in charge of the work.(Rates are exclusive of GST)

Providing  and  laying  in  position  Cement  Concrete   for  all  Sub  structures  of building,  Irrigation  works,  Sub  structure  works  of  bridges,  Drain  works    & other  parallel  works  from  0.50m  to  3.50  m  height.  The  granite/trap/basalt crushed  graded  coarse  aggregates    and  fine  aggregates    as  per  relevant  IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers,   laid in layers, well compacted using needle   vibrators, providing weep holes wherever necessary, including all lead & lifts,  cost of all materials of quality, confirming to the requirements of   relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. - M 20   Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse  aggregates ---- With all leads and lifts cost and conveyance of all materials, cost of labour, curing, hire charges of machinery equipment, transportation charges, loading and unloading chargesand all other incidental charges complete as per standard technical detailed specification and directions of the Engineer in charge of the work.(Rates are exclusive of GST)

Steel Fabrication
Supplying,   fitting   and   placing   TMT   FE   550   /   550D   Steel   Reinforcement including  cost  of  all  materials,  machinery,  labour,  cleaning,  straightening, cutting, bending, hooking, laping/welding joints, tying with binding wire / soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification. All other type of structures ---- With all leads and lifts cost and conveyance of all materials, cost of labour, curing, hire charges of machinery equipment, transportation charges, loading and unloading chargesand all other incidental charges complete as per standard technical detailed specification and directions of the Engineer in charge of the work.(Rates are exclusive of GST)

Manual Means -
Construction  of  Embankment  by  excavating  the  available  approved  Gravel/ Murrum deposited at a place or borrow pits during or prior excavation with all lifts and lead, transportation to site, spreading, grading to required slope and compacting to meet the requirement complete as per specifications, including cost of labour,rolling,water,all materials,usage& all other appurtenaces required to complete the work. ---- With all leads and lifts cost and conveyance of all materials, cost of labour, curing, hire charges of machinery equipment, transportation charges, loading and unloading chargesand all other incidental charges complete as per standard technical detailed specification and directions of the Engineer in charge of the work.(Rates are exclusive of GST)

Manual Means -
Refilling   available   earth   around   trenches/pipelines,   cables   in   layers   not exceeding 20 cms in depth, compacting Each deposited layer by ramming after watering with a lead upto 50 m, and lift upto 1.5 m. Including cost of all labour complete as per specifications ---- With all leads and lifts cost and conveyance of all materials, cost of labour, curing, hire charges of machinery equipment, transportation charges, loading and unloading chargesand all other incidental charges complete as per standard technical detailed specification and directions of the Engineer in charge of the work.(Rates are exclusive of GST)

Providing  and  laying  in  Cement  Concrete    for  all  Basement  &  surface  level works,  return  walls,  retaining  walls,  sunken  floors  etc.  The    granite/trap/ basalt  crushed graded coarse aggregates  and fine aggregates  as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers, laid in layers, well compacted using needle  vibrators, providing weep holes wherever necessary, including all lead & lifts,  cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all   other   appurtenances    required to complete the work as per technical  specifications. - M 30   Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse  aggregates ---- With all leads and lifts cost and conveyance of all materials, cost of labour, curing, hire charges of machinery equipment, transportation charges, loading and unloading chargesand all other incidental charges complete as per standard technical detailed specification and directions of the Engineer in charge of the work.(Rates are exclusive of GST)

Painting on concrete surface - Providing and applying 2 coats of water based cement paint to unplastered concrete surface after cleaning the surface of dirt, dust, oil, grease, efflorescence and applying paint @ of 1 litre for 2 m2.. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 800 ---- With all leads and lifts cost and conveyance of all materials, cost of labour, curing, hire charges of machinery equipment, transportation charges, loading and unloading chargesand all other incidental charges complete as per standard technical detailed specification and directions of the Engineer in charge of the work.(Rates are exclusive of GST)
